fixRound: Round 2 (reviewer fixes applied): list vertical rhythm restored, all small texts routed through faText (1.1x Persian size compensation + explicit line-heights), ASCII hyphens replaced with en dashes, and the non-mirrored map composition explicitly justified in the file header.

font.reason: Restrained enterprise/product UI (a Salesforce-like MQL list). Vazirmatn is a variable Persian UI sans with dependable joining, Persian punctuation, ZWNJ coverage and real weight variation for the title/list hierarchy at 11-15px sizes. Verified rendered (no fallback) in all inspected frames.

translation.scope: All visible copy on both faces of the flipping panel: enterprise list title + 7 row titles/subtitles, tab row, recency label, location-filter button, two filter groups, and the old-page title/metadata chips. Persian digits were not needed (Q3 is translated as فصل سوم).
translation.copy_notes: Latin product tokens kept inside Persian copy, isolated with <bdi> where needed ((MQL) in the panel title renders with correct paren placement). ZWNJ in بسته‌شده، ساخته‌شده، وایت‌بردها، فایل‌ها، پایپ‌لاین، سرنخ‌ها. ASCII ' - ' separator replaced with ' – ' (en dash with spaces) in حساب سازمانی بزرگ – بریتانیا and سرنخ سازمانی باز – پیگیری. Persian ی/ک throughout.

rtlDecisions.what: FaRoot wrapper: direction rtl + Vazirmatn for the whole demo.
rtlDecisions.action: RTL applies to the panel UI surfaces only; map SVG geometry, tile coordinates, camera path and all timings untouched.
rtlDecisions.why: Reading-direction styling belongs to text surfaces; the scene is physical.

rtlDecisions.what: Main enterprise list (right column) and filter rail (left column).
rtlDecisions.action: RTL flex mirrors the reading hierarchy: list on the right (reading side), filter rail on the left; separator border-left→border-right with padding on the correct side of it; row icons sit at the reading-side edge; header row/marker and chips right-aligned.
rtlDecisions.why: Sidebar/rail/list order follows reading direction. Panel size, radius, glow and placement unchanged.

rtlDecisions.what: Row pitch and bottom padding of the 7-row list.
rtlDecisions.action: Explicit lineHeight 1.25 on row title/sub (fs-scaled 15px/12px), row marginTop 13.5→9, panel title lineHeight 1.25, tabs/labels lineHeight 1.35. Result: ~43px pitch (original ~41px) and the list now ends with ~95px of empty bottom padding inside the 520px panel, matching the original's ~100px instead of crowding the edge (~17px before the fix).
rtlDecisions.why: Vazirmatn's default line box is far taller than the Latin original's, which inflated the pitch to ~52px and pushed the last row against the panel bottom. The original's airy bottom whitespace is part of the composition; the rhythm was re-derived, not the panel geometry changed.

rtlDecisions.what: Tabs, recency label, row title/sub, filter button label, filter group labels and filter items.
rtlDecisions.action: All routed through faText() (1.1x Persian size compensation, letterSpacing 0, no textTransform) with explicit line-heights; the 8-item tab row still fits its column at the larger size (gap 16→15).
rtlDecisions.why: 11-12px raw Persian text was undersized and low-contrast at 1920x1080; the kit's compensation applies uniformly, and the layout was re-measured to stay within panel bounds.

rtlDecisions.what: Page title, marker and metadata chips.
rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored header (marker right of Persian title), chips translated with faText(11.5, lineHeight 1.3); gray document bars right-aligned as ragged RTL text-block surrogates, widths unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: Reading-order UI; the bars are abstract placeholders so their physical widths carry no reading semantics.

rtlDecisions.component: Map composition (tiles, pipes, rects) — NOT mirrored
rtlDecisions.what: Figma/GitHub (left of centre), Salesforce (top), GDrive/Dropbox (right), 9 neon rectangles, pulses flowing icon→hub.
rtlDecisions.action: Deliberately left in original coordinates; pulse direction and per-pipe phase offsets unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: (a) It is a radial network centred on the hub panel — a symmetric, direction-neutral constellation with no reading-order meaning; (b) tiles are brand marks (physical, keep-side); (c) pulses are a physical delivery metaphor (apps push data into the hub), not a reading sweep; (d) the panel sits dead-centre on the flip axis, so there is no left/right-weighted layout to re-balance. This rationale is now written in the file header comment.

rtlDecisions.what: rotateY 0→180 (f14–49, ease-out cubic), 90° bloom pulse at ~f21, icons f52, pipes f62, 9-frame growth, continuous transport flow.
rtlDecisions.action: No timing, easing, seed, duration, fps or transform values changed.
rtlDecisions.why: The fast flip with tail deceleration and the two-beat synchronized connection are the card's identity per the source prompt.

rasterHandling.action: No raster or baked-in text assets. All brand marks are inline SVG/CSS vectors left intact.

verification.visualInspection: Viewed fa/orig pairs after the fix: f10 (front panel: mirrored header, chips, gray bars), f38 (mid-flip back face: list fits with clear bottom padding), f100 and f149 (resting hub page: list ends ~95px above the panel bottom like the original ~100px, en dashes render, tabs on one line, filter rail compact and top-anchored, (MQL) parens correct, no leftover Latin/Chinese). Full timeline renders clean (IntegrationHubMap.fa.mp4).
verification.timing: No animation beat moved; only panel-internal text sizing/line-height/margins changed, all inside the fixed 820x520 panel.

lessons: FaRoot inherits the browser default line-height of the loaded Persian font; variable Persian UI fonts like Vazirmatn have a much taller default line box than Latin UI stacks (Avenir/Helvetica ~1.2). Fixed-size mock-UI panels must re-derive every stack pitch with explicit line-heights (~1.25) instead of trusting the inherited default, or lists overflow the panel's intended bottom padding.

When applying faText()'s 1.1x size compensation late (fix round), audit dense tab/filter rows for horizontal overflow at the same time — the 8-item tab row needed its gap trimmed 16→15 to stay on one line.
